text_block_list.text:
One day, after our journey together with <chrname> 
reached a milestone.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer <username>...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
For our next day off... would you be 
willing to spare me some time?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
There's a place I'd really love to go with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: We have arrived at the onsen ryokan!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It's such a lovely building. There's a 
wide variety of hot springs, too, and they 
say you can enjoy all kinds of therapeutic 
benefits...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm getting all excited!
choice_data_list: Why a hot spring all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
To commemorate our three years together, I 
wanted to invite Meek. I absolutely had to 
do some scouting beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I can't be flustered or looking around all 
nervously in front of that child, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What a wonderful bath. It feels 
almost like a waste to only stay for a day 
trip.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, have you visited the Hana-no-Yu 
bath yet?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The bath had a lovely jasmine-like aroma, 
and it felt so wonderfully relaxing.
choice_data_list:
That sounds like something Meek would 
love.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm sure they'll be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I got a bit lightheaded. Would you 
like to take a walk outside?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... It really is chilly outside, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer <username>. About Meek, I...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...No. Whenever I think about Umamusume, 
there's something that always crosses my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume and her Trainer are a 
two-person, three-legged team.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We've desperately pushed through a harsh 
world... but we were never just alone, 
were we?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As we walked, our backs were supported by 
so many people. They were watching over 
us.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
With eyes shining like stars…… they 
delivered so many heartfelt feelings to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Something precious that isn't written 
even in the *Trainer's White Paper*.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
In these three years, I've learned so 
much.
choice_data_list: We'll need to add more details.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Yes, that is a splendid idea.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...I have learned so much from you as 
well, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As a rival, as a comrade, she taught me so 
many things I never knew.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though my world as a Trainer has 
broadened immensely.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. In that case... I suppose the 
feeling is mutual.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I want to create my very own 
"Trainer's White Paper."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Writing down everything learned over these 
past three yearsâ the successes, the 
failures, all of it.
choice_data_list: How should we start the first sentence?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Would this be the one after 
all?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"To find a lifelong rival―― with whom you 
can support and push each other forward."
